title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch Solid Brass, Freestanding | Antique Copper | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a paper towel roll holder that stays put on the counter? This freestanding paper towel holder stand keeps the roll upright for space-saving storage and a steady pull when you tear off sheets in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style kitchens.

Highlights:
- Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
- Coordinates with other Carolina hardware for artisan-inspired warmth
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Coordinate a matching Carolina look with the Carolina Collection
- Solid brass construction with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs & Installation:
- Collection: Carolina
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Freestanding
- Assembly required: No
- Dimensions: 6.5 in L x 6.5 in W x 14.4 in H; projection 6.5 in
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Product weight: 4 lb

- Finish variety: Multiple designer finish options available
